_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ozali komona Klondike Solitaire. Limbisi ya yo ezali kobebisa kadi zote kwenda libaya ya ntina.

Mikano ya Komona:
- Libaya ya ntina (F1-F4): Kozua kutoka Asu kwenda Mokonzi na libula
- Libaya ya mokili (T1-T7): Kozua kasi na kulungana bwa libula (mokili nyonso na mokili ndombe, mokili ndombe na mokili nyonso)
- Libaya: Zua kadi kwenda libaku
- Libaku (W): Kadi ya libele ezali na kati ya komona

Mikano:
- 'draw' - Zua kadi kutoka libaya kwenda libaku
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Bebisa kadi kati ya libaya
  Nkano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count ekoki kozala 'all', ekopesa bebisa kadi zote za libele.
- 'forfeit' - Komona ekoki kozala na kati ya ntina ya sika
- Nkoma ya libaya: W (libaku), F1-F4 (libaya ya ntina), T1-T7 (libaya ya mokili)

Okoki komona misala mingi na ntango moko kwa kozungisa na virgule:
  Nkano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Mokonzi nde akoki kozala na libaya ya mokili ya libele.
Misala ekoki kozala na ntango - soki mosala moko ekoki kozala na kati, misala iliyobaki ekoki kozala na kati.
Tika 'forfeit' soki ozali komona ekoki kozala na kati ya ntina.
